correctness.summary: Even log-concave block-average densities remain symmetric decreasing under products, proving the exact concentration center. A logarithmic change of variables turns the product into an additive convolution whose constant tail and integrable correction give the first two small-ball coefficients. The same expansion yields the density singularity and, by a gamma integral plus Stirling, the exact high-p norm constant. Irwin-Hall evaluation and a Fourier-Laplace expansion give the explicit block constant and its Gaussian large-block correction.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The direct 2026 source establishes the canonical block-product profile and density growth only up to degree-dependent constants. Searches did not locate the exact all-center maximizer, explicit leading block constant, second logarithmic coefficient, or exact high-p constant stated here. Irwin-Hall formulas and general Mellin-product methods are classical prior art and are not claimed as new. Older product-distribution literature may contain an equivalent specialization and was not exhaustively inspected.

value.summary: The result resolves the exact constants and first correction for the source paper's canonical sharpness models, shows that zero is the exact concentration center at every radius, and identifies a universal Gaussian-block limiting constant with its first finite-size correction.

limitations: Exact constants are proved only for the centered block-product models.
The second-order expansion fixes the block sizes while the small-ball parameter tends to zero.
No uniform second-order remainder is claimed for simultaneously growing block sizes.
No optimal general constant is obtained for arbitrary multi-affine polynomials or admissible partitions.
The singleton-partition dimensional exponent gap from the source paper remains open.
Classical Irwin-Hall formulas and general Mellin-product methods are prior art.
Older product-distribution literature was not exhaustively inspected.
Cross-model review has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Cross-model review: not yet performed.
